name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-06-29, at wavelengths from 1.13 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
